name: inspira-world-map
title: World Map
blurb: Animated paths and pulsing dots connect global locations on a dotted map.
description: Renders a dotted world map with animated SVG paths drawing between geographic coordinates (start/end points). Includes pulsing circle animations at location markers and customizable gradient-colored connection lines.
use_when: Team/company pages, dashboards, or landing pages showcasing global reach, distributed operations, or global connections.
avoid_when: When real geographic accuracy is critical; uses simplified projection for visual appeal rather than precision.
a11y: Map image has alt text; animations are decorative; no interactive elements or keyboard navigation; respects motion timing via SVG animate tags.
